proposed_enforcement.openssh: OpenVox owns a dedicated root allowlist file; Match User root uses only that AuthorizedKeysFile, disables AuthorizedKeysCommand, and requires publickey. Explicitly retain approved native Proxmox self keys and necessary automation. Proxmox may maintain its own file but it is not an additional effective authorization source.
proposed_enforcement.automation: Pin an explicit identity; replace universal host SSH with scoped API tokens following existing Wolf pattern, or a carefully constrained forced command. Retain dedicated unlock-only keys.
proposed_enforcement.dropbear: Fully manage key files and config on both nodes, rebuild every retained initramfs and sync/verify EFI copies on changes.
proposed_enforcement.reporting: Alert on policy drift and failed/stale OpenVox runs; scheduled convergence alone is not immediate prevention.
proposed_enforcement.nonroot: If Kerberos-only human login is intended, disable publickey authentication for the human account; disabling root SSSD lookup alone does not close this path.
